name: Locally Feasible but Globally Incompatible Coefficient Rows
definition: Let $C=\{01,10\}\subseteq\{0,1\}^2$. Its missing patterns $00$ and $11$ have normalized rows $(\alpha,1-\alpha)$ and $(\beta,1-\beta)$.
properties: At concept $01$, local feasibility is exactly $\alpha<\beta$; at concept $10$, it is exactly $\alpha>\beta$. Each local relation is a nonempty open triangle in $(0,1)^2$, but their intersection and hence $\mathcal A(C)$ are empty. Combinatorially, each coordinate is shattered and neither is strongly shattered.
